title: Largest known Roman mosaic, beneath Baths of Trajan, opens to the public
summary: The largest known Roman mosaic has been discovered beneath the Baths of Trajan in Rome and is now open to the public. This extraordinary archaeological find spans a significant area and provides unprecedented insight into Roman artistic and cultural achievements during the Imperial period. The site offers visitors a rare opportunity to view exceptionally preserved ancient craftsmanship firsthand.
problem_solved: Provides public access to one of the most significant archaeological discoveries of Roman art and heritage.
why_valuable: It offers invaluable educational and cultural experiences, preserving and sharing Rome's ancient artistic heritage with modern audiences while advancing our understanding of Roman civilization.
